name: Andrey Pulyaev
summary: A lanky, durable range fighter who makes talented opponents' nights ugly by picking at range; lost three straight (decision to Gautier, submission to Nursulton Ruziboev).

how_they_fight.Striking: Stays long and picks shots; frustrating rather than dangerous.
how_they_fight.Grappling: Takedown defense about 53%; submitted in June.
how_they_fight.Defense: Durable, but hasn't faced this level of power.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Crafty but can't turn it into wins against top opposition.

sources.author: E. Spencer Kyte
